headline: Public Storage Q2 FFO Misses on Same-Store NOI Decline, Revenues Beat
summary: PSA lags Q2 core FFO estimates, but higher revenues, acquisitions and a stronger 2026 outlook highlight how expansion is helping offset same-store pressure.
